name: bitbucket
title: Bitbucket Search
description: The extension allow you to quickly access repositories, pipelines and pull-requests in Bitbucket
author: Francois

commands.name: searchRepositories
commands.title: Search Repositories
commands.subtitle: Bitbucket
commands.description: Showing bitbucket results on repositories search

commands.name: searchMyOpenPullRequests
commands.title: Search My Open Pull Requests
commands.subtitle: Bitbucket
commands.description: Showing open pull requests for the current user

preferences.name: maxRepoAgeDays
preferences.title: Max Repository Age (Days)
preferences.description: Speeds up this search by skipping repositories not updated within this many days. Set to 0 for no limit (scan every repository).

commands.name: searchAllPullRequests
commands.title: Search All Open Pull Requests
commands.subtitle: Bitbucket
commands.description: Showing all open pull requests in the workspace

preferences.name: maxRepoAgeDays
preferences.title: Max Repository Age (Days)
preferences.description: Speeds up this search by skipping repositories not updated within this many days. Set to 0 for no limit (scan every repository).

commands.name: notifications
commands.title: Notifications
commands.subtitle: Bitbucket
commands.description: Shows Bitbucket notifications in the menu bar: review requests, approvals and requested changes, comments and mentions on pull requests, merged or declined pull requests, and failed pipelines.

preferences.name: alwaysShow
preferences.label: Always Show
preferences.description: Show the menu bar item even when you have no notifications.

preferences.name: showCount
preferences.label: Show Notification Count
preferences.description: Show the notification count in the menu bar.

preferences.name: maxRepoAgeDays
preferences.title: Max Repository Age (Days)
preferences.description: Skips repositories not updated within this many days to keep background refreshes fast. Set to 0 for no limit.

preferences.name: apiToken
preferences.title: API Token
preferences.description: Create an API token at https://id.atlassian.com/manage-profile/security/api-tokens. Required scopes: read:user:bitbucket, read:workspace:bitbucket, read:repository:bitbucket, read:pullrequest:bitbucket, read:pipeline:bitbucket (or simply read:*), plus write:pullrequest:bitbucket for review actions.
